release_notes: v1.2.0: Adds an editable polishing system prompt in the Polish tab. The prompt is saved locally, applied to live polishing and History reprocessing, and can be reset to the built-in prompt; edits no longer require another app build. The prompt, transcript, and custom vocabulary are sent as text when polishing is enabled; audio is never sent. Connection tests use synthetic text. ARM64-only; updates remain manual.
